name: u8x
title: The community's U8 word with exit frames (126 helpers end at a frame of dimension 4 or 8)
statement: OpenAI's UniformFourier statement (DFT of every length and convolution), only the exponent and seven names changed

compared_with.what: Lean-checked record before these packages (Jeremy Kothe's #588 circuit in Ryan Shea's Lean tree)

tree_change: the tree's lakefile.lean needs one more library line for the five XExit modules: lean_lib XExit where globs := #[`XExit.+] (logs/colab-xexit/lakefile-tail.txt); apply-overlay.sh does not add it
machine: Google Colab VM: Linux x86-64, Intel Xeon 2.20 GHz, 8 logical processors, 51 GiB, kernel 6.6.122+ without Landlock, no systemd

new_lean.Work/KLow: exit frames on the U8 word: ExitEnd, LabelsX, ZCheck, NoY, GlueX

checks.what: the 73 modules of logs/agent-notes/MODULES-as-run.txt compiled one at a time with plain lean on the first Colab machine, all rc 0 (23 minutes in all); the statement files, Axioms and the controls in the checks step; the comparator's own Lake build then built the chain again (9,289 jobs, 'Build completed successfully')
the five XExit modules (exit frames) were compiled earlier in the same Colab tree by a separate build, from the same sources (logs/colab-xexit/xx-hashes.txt); the Lake runs below replayed them
the two theorems and hillsU8X_program depend on propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only; so do exitRC, validX, ginv_cost, fitsS, price
tools/Compare.lean against the statement one unit stronger (12704024): RESULT: FAIL
official comparator inside the stand-in jail2.sh: nanoda and Lean kernels accept, 'Your solution is okay!' (77 minutes including its Lake build, 9.4 GB)
official comparator rejects the configuration one unit stronger: Const does not match ... decimalExponentU8X (40 minutes)
zcheck_control and endkx_control proved (axiom propext only); the control file was compiled on the Colab but is not in overlay/
no independent rebuild or review log of this package is in the repository
the leaderboard's own verifier has not been run on this package
